key_findings: **Six candidates were already cataloged**: BCS-Y-0158 (LuaActorImpl slot 41 _onPreWarp), BCS-Y-0159 (slot 42 _onPostWarp), BCS-Y-1600 (_onInit), BCS-Y-1624 (_onPreWarp firer), BCS-Y-1625 (_onPostWarp firer), and BCS-Y-1639 (_onChocoboRentalRide/_onChocoboWarpRide). All six were corroborated without duplicate entries.

**Real gap filled = the two engine-side gate trampolines**: BCS-Y-0158/0159 already named the chain slot41->FUN_008A4410->FUN_006FEDE0 and slot42->FUN_008A44D0->FUN_006FEF10, but the trampolines FUN_008A4410 (preWarp gate, BCS-Y-1789) and FUN_008A44D0 (postWarp gate, BCS-Y-1788) themselves were never cataloged. Both gate on a DesktopWidget lookup by SID 0xC0000024 + dynamic-cast to LuaControl/DesktopWidget; preWarp additionally requires DesktopWidget+0x5C != 0.

**_fadeIn vtable-slot discrepancy**: an earlier note placed _fadeIn (FUN_006DE760) at slot +0xE8; the live decomp dispatches +0xEC. The other three fade implementations use +0xF0/+0x100/+0x108. BCS-Y-1784 records +0xEC as authoritative.

**_onInit ties directly into the spawn-ACK chain**: get_xrefs_to FUN_006F6D60 (_onInit firer, BCS-Y-1600) returns a single caller, FUN_006C8CF0 (the spawn-ADD handler, BCS-Y-1780). The ring-drain ADD path that emits c2s 0x133 also fires _onInit per actor.

**FUN_0075E860 sibling-emitter confirmed**: 3 callers (the two teardown emit sites + FUN_006E42E0). Same opcode (0x130) and gating-thunk (FUN_004D6D30 BCS-Y-0983) as BCS-Y-0329 FUN_0075E8D0. The 2x-0x130 spawn-ADD ACK count of section 17 is the two teardown sites firing this emitter.

**Data symbols confirm the blocker finding-by-absence**: both NowLoading data symbols have zero xrefs - the overlay is shown/hidden by Lua (_fadeInNowLoadingForNoticeEventJustInArea / _fadeOut), not by any hard-coded C++ reference. The loading-screen dismiss is therefore gated on the Lua callback cascade (_onInit + _onPostWarp), which is gated in turn on the spawn-burst driving the engine state-diff - not on a single dismiss opcode.
